![Trekv6 in six palettes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nbetcher/pebbleface-trekv4/v6.0.0/docs/images/faces.png)

**Trekv4 is now Trekv6: a ground-up rebuild.** The LCARS frame is drawn live by the
watch instead of shipped as pictures. That lets you build your own palette, gives
every supported Pebble a layout tuned to its screen, and lets Settings show you
your watchface exactly as it will look before you save.

### Highlights
- **Live preview in Settings.** A preview of your watchface stays pinned at the top and redraws instantly with every change. Tap any part of it to recolor it. On Pebble Time 2 it runs the watchface's own drawing code, translated to JavaScript, so it matches the watch pixel for pixel.
- **Drawn in code.** Vector frame pieces with smooth, anti-aliased edges. No theme images.
- **Make it yours.** Keep one of 12 classic themes, or pick your own colors for the frame's three regions, the text, the background, the Bluetooth symbol and the battery bars.
- **Pebble Time 2 and Pebble 2 Duo support**, alongside Pebble Time and Pebble 2.
- **Red Alert.** Nine Star Trek-themed disconnect vibrations, optional repeats, and an LCARS popup you shake away.
- **Weather with no account.** Now powered by Open-Meteo. Location stays off until you turn it on.
- **Quiet Time indicator is back**, plus heart rate on supported watches.

### Also
- Settings reorganized into clear sections that show only what your watch supports.
- Messages to the watch are queued and retried, so saved settings and weather aren't lost.
- A full code audit fixed a long list of bugs, and 141 automated tests now guard the result.
- Installs over Trekv4, and your settings and colors carry over automatically.

### Good to know
- **The original Pebble and Pebble Steel are no longer supported.** Their memory is too small for Trekv6. Keep the version you have installed.
- **Round watches are no longer supported.** Pebble Time Round owners should stay on Trekv4 5.2.
